description: Paired persistent-prior versus evaluation-only native MPPI on one frozen AMBI-XQC checkpoint. Uses the checkpoint TOLD dynamics/reward and online twin XQC soft-Q mean converted into raw reward units. No XQC inner optimization is run.

controller.description: Paired episodes with frozen weights and real normalization; MPPI retains native search, weighted elite selection, and episode warm starts.

prior.description: Execute the frozen persistent actor tanh mean without imagined work.

mppi.description: Native MPPI: H3, 512 candidates, 64 elites, 24 actor trajectories, configured six iterations (eight for Humanoid's 21 actions), online twin-Q mean scaled to raw reward units, weighted elite action without added Gaussian noise.
